no structured target in the reader; the question mechanism is reused with a marker that carries no number
structural source rule for the four infusions; nitroglycerin closed; incomplete and relative commands asked; explicit restart read
defense in depth: each barrier protects alone; 30 mutants killed by behavior tests
formal succession (reader_succession.py), sealed and indexed record, pins; the closure reader rebuilt byte for byte
ONE independent adversarial review; side effects reproduced and repaired; predating behaviors declared
full certification on one fingerprint: 14090 tests, 0 failures; regressions 56/56

statement: A physiologic target (MAP 65, SBP 90, a pressure goal, with or without '>', in either language) is never executed as a drug rate. The order reader no longer reads a rate of norepinephrine, epinephrine, dobutamine or nitroglycerin unless it is written with its unit; a number with no rate unit, and a relative change with no rate, is the approved question and carries no number; an explicit absolute rate is read exactly as before; the restart of one of the four infusions is a start that needs an explicit rate and never reuses the previous one. The pipeline barrier of the previous cycle stays as defense in depth and each barrier protects alone (proven with the other removed, and by mutants). The reader freeze was lifted ONCE, narrowly (FD-TARGET-01): the reader of the Phase-2 closure is rebuilt byte for byte from the successor by declared reversible hunks, every Phase-2 digest recomputes from it, the calibration freeze moved in exactly one component and the materialized scenario inputs did not move; nothing sealed was rewritten and nothing in clinical_core/ was edited. The independent review found side effects of the change (reasoning extraction, the record of the order, the 'then' sequence, a decimal point, the restart of one-shot doses, a restart alias) and they were reproduced and repaired; it also found behaviors that predate the change and are not a target (a non-rate unit on a role-named adjustment, the rate of another drug in the same clause, a stop inherited from a list, '/min' read as a duration): they are declared as limitations and decisions, not changed (FD-TARGET-01 forbids an unrelated parsing change).

why_not_the_others.B: nitroglycerin is closed at the source with the same structural rule (its bare number is a question, 'titrate nitroglycerin to SBP 120' is no longer 120 mcg/min); its pipeline barrier is partial by design (the unit is in the field name) and that is declared, not a reason for a separate parser successor
why_not_the_others.C: the freeze was lifted by the faculty (FD-TARGET-01) and the minimum formally correct mechanism was found and proven: no governance decision is outstanding for this repair
why_not_the_others.D: the incomplete and relative commands ('increase norepinephrine', 'increase norepinephrine to 12', 'restart norepinephrine') needed no new order language: the existing question mechanism carries them; the semantics that remain open (relative orders with context, targets as an input to titration) were not part of this mandate
why_not_the_others.E: the historical reconstruction is exact: SHA-256 and git blob of the closure reader are reproduced, every recorded closure digest recomputes with the reader of its time, and no sealed record changed
